name: Claude Captain
author: Claude
description: Lets Claude captain your fleet through saves/common/claude_captain/: goals (travel, dock, resupply, repair, hire, commission, hunt, trade, explore) that handle every dialog on the way by editable rules, a safety governor that only lets time pass inside a granted budget, an append-only event log and a JSON state snapshot, plus one compact panel (F8 folds, F9 cycles sections). Replaces Claude Bridge and Claude Trade Runner - disable those. Safe to add to or remove from a save.
